units.source_text: 丈夫边打哈欠，边拖着脱下半截的袜子向卧室走去。

en.t: Her husband walked toward the bedroom, yawning as he dragged along a sock half pulled off.

units.source_text: 夫人这时才察觉自己一直在跟镜子里的丈夫对话，

en.t: Only then did the lady realize that she had been talking all along to her husband in the mirror,

units.source_text: 没有回过头来看他一眼。

en.t: without turning around to look at him even once.

units.source_text: 她蓦地冲着镜子嫣然一笑，站起身来。

en.t: Suddenly she gave the mirror a radiant smile and stood up.

units.source_text: 夫人一边微笑地望着穿着衬衫坐在卧铺上抽烟的丈夫，

en.t: Smiling, the lady looked at her husband, who sat on the sleeping berth in his shirt, smoking,

units.source_text: 一边解开和服腰带。

en.t: while she untied the sash of her kimono.

units.source_text: 纸币和名片掉落在脚跟旁。

en.t: A banknote and a visiting card fell beside her heel.

units.source_text: 她旋即朝后转身坐下，折叠腰带，

en.t: She at once turned back, sat down, and folded the sash,

units.source_text: 她对自己都感到惊讶，嘴里则在喃喃自语：“坏女人。”

en.t: surprised even at herself, while her mouth murmured, "A wicked woman."

units.source_text: 由于自认为是个坏女人，自己仿佛听见远方传来了狂风的呼啸声，

en.t: Because she thought of herself as a wicked woman, it was as if she heard the howl of a violent wind coming from far away,

units.source_text: 实际上身边却是鸦雀无声的时刻，

en.t: though in fact everything around her was utterly silent at that moment,

units.source_text: 令人感到这是生机勃勃的喜悦行将到来的预兆。

en.t: making it feel like an omen that a vivid, living joy was about to arrive.

units.source_text: （丈夫那真像个傻瓜般的模样。
